infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Beginora reads your calendar to help you plan around existing commitments.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Beginora reads and creates calendar events to help you schedule tasks.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Beginora reads your contacts to help you delegate or schedule with people.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Beginora uses the microphone for voice input so you can describe tasks hands-free.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Beginora uses speech recognition to convert your voice into task descriptions.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Beginora creates reminders to help you follow through on your first actions.

plugins.calendarPermission: Allow Beginora to access your calendar to help you plan tasks around your schedule.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Beginora to access your contacts to help you delegate and schedule with people.
